answer: One concrete mechanism: per-head cost plus standing decay. Every identity must first mine a proof-of-work admission ticket (the copper it spends before joining), then answer an original, peer-attested challenge each epoch; an identity that goes silent decays into a canyon of low standing. A sybil farm thus pays a recurring real cost for every fake head, forever, which kills mass-fabrication economics. A fake account that merely whispers and stops answering loses all weight within roughly a day and a half.
